meta.title: Our Day at the Lake
meta.textType: functional: a day plan with times

paragraphs: I am Lily. This is our Sunday at the lake. Here is what we do. Seven o'clock: we get up early and eat rice. Ten past eight: we take the bus with Grandpa. "Is it a long ride?" asks Tom. "No," says Dad. "It is only twenty-five minutes by bus." Mom has a big bag with water and fruit in it. Pip sits on the bag and looks out of the window. Twenty-five to nine: we get to the lake. When we get off the bus, Pip runs to the water.

Ten o'clock: we walk by the water and take pictures. Eleven o'clock: Grandpa and I sail a small boat. When the wind comes, the boat moves on the lake. The lake is green and quiet, and we see two ducks. I help Grandpa with the boat, and he says, "Well done, Lily!" Tom and Dad play with Pip by the water. "Can Pip come in the boat?" I ask. "Not today," says Grandpa. Pip finds his red ball and is happy again.

Twelve o'clock: we eat lunch at the café. We have sandwiches and a big watermelon. "How much watermelon do you want, Tom?" asks Mom. "More, please!" says Tom. The sun is hot, so we sit under a big tree. Half past two: Tom and I swim in the lake. A quarter to four: we walk back to the bus. A quarter past four: the bus goes home. Pip is asleep on my legs. A good day!
text.summary: Lily writes the plan for Sunday at the lake with times for each activity. The family takes the bus, sails a boat, eats watermelon, and goes home.
